items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: Sy Oliver is mentioned by the interviewer in a list of musicians and arrangers (Paul Whiteman, Benny Goodman, Fletcher Henderson, Count Basie, Tommy Dorsey) without any statement from the interviewee indicating a personal or professional connection.

ctx.x: You know we had Paul Whiteman and now we've got Benny Goodman and then Fletcher Henderson, Sy Oliver.
